newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: POSCO to suspend steel supply to Kia.
newsitem.headline: POSCO to suspend steel supply to Kia.

text.p: The ailing Kia Group, South Korea's eighth largest conglomerate, said on Friday Pohang Iron and Steel Co (POSCO) had notified it would suspend steel supplies to Kia Motors without cash payment.
A Kia statement said POSCO's notification came after Kia defaulted on Tuesday on promissory notes issued to POSCO for steel purchases in May.
The statement said POSCO sells 300 tonnes of steel, or 15 billion won worth, each month to Kia Motors.
Kia said its steel stockpiles would run out around the end of this month and officials of the two companies were negotiating payment terms.
It said POSCO wanted payment guarantees from Kia and its banks.
